Both changes are stored and I read them back.

- **Main colour:** set to dark green `#1B5E20` in `theme.assistedModeColors.primary`. The portal's assisted mode uses this value as the main colour.
- **Menu:** "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" is now the third item in the portal menu, after Accueil and Catalogue de données. It is a "Page libre" pointing at the page `jeunesse`, and it has no custom label, so it shows the page's own title.

The one thing to check: the computed palette `theme.colors.primary` still reads `#1976D2`. The portal's notes say the palettes are recalculated when a draft is saved in the back-office, and this API doesn't run that step. Open the portal's theme settings in the back-office to confirm the green appears, and save the draft there if it doesn't.

I didn't change anything else. I resent the full `theme` object to make this one edit, and the other values match what I read before.
